question: The value of (1018)² - 1019 × 1017 + 1015 × 1012 - 1016 × 1011 is:
solution:
**Given:**

(1018)² - 1019 × 1017 + 1015 × 1012 - 1016 × 1011

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

(1018)2 - (1019 × 1017) + (1015 × 1012) - (1016 × 1011)

⇒ (10,36,324 - 10,36,323) + (10,27,180 - 10,27,176)

⇒ (1) + (4) = 5

**∴ The value of given equation is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** We can also do this question by using unit digits.

8² - 9 × 7 + 5 × 2 - 6 × 1

⇒ 4 - 3 + 0 - 6 = -5

10 - 5 = 5

∴ The answer has unit digit of 5. 

Hence, option 4 is correct.
